points.text: Both structures: $\text{4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl-C(OH)(CH}_{3}\text{)(CN)}$ [cyanohydrin: para-$\text{CH}_{2}\text{CH(CH}_{3}\text{)}_{2}$ phenyl with $\text{C(OH)(CH}_{3}\text{)(CN)}$ substituent] and $\text{4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl-C(CH}_{3}\text{)}_{2}\text{CO}_{2}\text{H}$ [para-$\text{CH}_{2}\text{CH(CH}_{3}\text{)}_{2}$ phenyl with $\text{C(CH}_{3}\text{)}_{2}\text{(CO}_{2}\text{H)}$ substituent]

J is J1: $\text{4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl-C(OH)(CH}_{3}\text{)CO}_{2}\text{H}$ or J2: $\text{4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl-C(CN)=CH}_{2}$ [para-$\text{CH}_{2}\text{CH(CH}_{3}\text{)}_{2}$ phenyl with $\text{C(OH)(CH}_{3}\text{)(CO}_{2}\text{H)}$ for J1 or $\text{C(CN)=CH}_{2}$ for J2]
